description: Audit one public web page with 69 checks across security, SEO, TLS, performance, transport, accessibility, links, mobile, DNS and agent readiness. Returns the score, grade and the problems found, most important first, each with an exact fix, plus an audit_id to pass to verify_fixes after changes. Passive: only fetches the page and the files it links to. 5 free audits a day; after that it explains the paid API (0.01 USDC per audit via x402).

url.description: Full http or https address of the page to audit, for example https://www.example.co.uk/

name: audit_site
title: Audit a web page
